sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Democrats retake Congress
geopolitical_news.summary: November midterms punish Bush over Iraq; defense secretary Rumsfeld resigns after heavy losses.

geopolitical_news.headline: Iraq violence spirals
geopolitical_news.summary: Sectarian bloodshed peaks in Baghdad; mounting US casualties deepen public opposition and political pressure.

sport.headline: Steelers win Super Bowl XL
sport.summary: Pittsburgh beats Seattle in Detroit in February for the franchise's fifth Super Bowl title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bush orders Iraq troop surge
geopolitical_news.summary: An extra 20,000 troops deploy in January; sectarian violence gradually falls by year-end under Petraeus' strategy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Subprime mortgage crisis erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: Housing defaults spread through summer; Bear Stearns funds collapse in August as credit markets freeze.

sport.headline: Patriots complete perfect regular season
sport.summary: New England goes 16-0, the first perfect regular season since the schedule expanded to sixteen games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lehman collapse triggers global crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: Lehman Brothers fails in September; credit markets convulse and governments worldwide rush massive bailouts.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: November victory over McCain makes Barack Obama the first Black US president, with a decisive Electoral College margin.

sport.headline: Phelps wins eight golds in Beijing
sport.summary: Michael Phelps sweeps all eight swimming events, the most golds ever at one Olympics.

geopolitical_news.headline: Stimulus passes; health reform battle begins
geopolitical_news.summary: The $787 billion ARRA passes in February; the fight over Obamacare dominates the year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama surges troops in Afghanistan
geopolitical_news.summary: December order sends 30,000 more troops as the Taliban insurgency intensifies across the south and east.

sport.headline: Steelers win Super Bowl XLIII
sport.summary: Pittsburgh edges Arizona in Tampa in February on a last-minute Santonio Holmes touchdown catch.

geopolitical_news.headline: Affordable Care Act becomes law
geopolitical_news.summary: Landmark health reform passes in March on party-line votes after a bruising fight in Congress.

geopolitical_news.headline: Tea Party wave in the midterms
geopolitical_news.summary: Republicans retake the House in November amid backlash to Obama and stimulus spending.

sport.headline: Saints win first Super Bowl
sport.summary: New Orleans beats Indianapolis in Miami in February, lifting a city still rebuilding five years after Katrina.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bin Laden killed in Pakistan raid
geopolitical_news.summary: May SEAL raid in Abbottabad ends the 9/11 mastermind's nearly decade on the run.

geopolitical_news.headline: Debt-ceiling crisis rattles markets
geopolitical_news.summary: August standoff brings the US near default; S&P strips its AAA credit rating for the first time.

sport.headline: Packers win Super Bowl XLV
sport.summary: Green Bay beats Pittsburgh in Dallas in February for the franchise's fourth title behind Aaron Rodgers' MVP performance.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama wins re-election
geopolitical_news.summary: November victory over Romney; Democrats hold the Senate despite a sluggish economy and high unemployment.

geopolitical_news.headline: Benghazi attack kills four Americans
geopolitical_news.summary: September assault on the US consulate in Libya, including the ambassador, sparks a political firestorm.

sport.headline: US tops the London medal table
sport.summary: Americans win 104 medals with 22 golds; Phelps retires as the most decorated Olympian ever.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government shutdown over Obamacare
geopolitical_news.summary: A 16-day October shutdown follows a failed GOP bid to defund the health law.

geopolitical_news.headline: Snowden exposes NSA surveillance
geopolitical_news.summary: June leaks reveal mass data collection; Snowden flees to Russia via Hong Kong, sparking a global privacy debate.

sport.headline: Heat repeat as NBA champions
sport.summary: Miami beats San Antonio in seven games in June; LeBron James earns Finals MVP again.

geopolitical_news.headline: US leads sanctions over Crimea
geopolitical_news.summary: Washington coordinates Western sanctions after Russia's March annexation of Crimea and backs Kyiv with aid.

geopolitical_news.headline: Airstrikes against ISIS begin
geopolitical_news.summary: US bombs ISIS targets in Iraq and Syria in August as the group seizes Mosul.

sport.headline: Seahawks win first Super Bowl
sport.summary: Seattle crushes Denver in New York in February; the Legion of Boom defense dominates from kickoff.

geopolitical_news.headline: Iran nuclear deal signed
geopolitical_news.summary: July JCPOA trades sanctions relief for strict curbs on Iran's nuclear program over the next decade.

geopolitical_news.headline: Paris climate accord adopted
geopolitical_news.summary: December deal commits the US and nearly 200 nations to emissions cuts in a landmark global pact.

sport.headline: US women win the World Cup
sport.summary: The USWNT beats Japan 5-2 in Vancouver; Lloyd's hat trick seals a third star.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: November upset over Clinton upends US politics and rattles global alliances, despite losing the popular vote.

geopolitical_news.headline: Russia accused of election interference
geopolitical_news.summary: US intelligence blames Moscow for hacks and leaks aimed at the campaign in a January assessment.

sport.headline: Cubs end 108-year drought
sport.summary: Chicago beats Cleveland in seven games for its first World Series since 1908 in a November classic.

geopolitical_news.headline: Travel ban sparks protests
geopolitical_news.summary: January order restricting entry from several Muslim-majority nations faces court blocks and airport demonstrations nationwide.

geopolitical_news.headline: Charlottesville rally turns deadly
geopolitical_news.summary: August white-supremacist rally kills a counterprotester; Trump's response draws bipartisan condemnation after he blames both sides.

sport.headline: Patriots' historic Super Bowl comeback
sport.summary: New England erases a 25-point deficit to beat Atlanta in overtime in Houston in February.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trade war with China begins
geopolitical_news.summary: July tariffs on Chinese goods worth tens of billions open a multi-year conflict roiling global markets.

geopolitical_news.headline: Democrats retake the House
geopolitical_news.summary: November midterms deliver a check on Trump's power amid record turnout and suburban revolt against the president.

sport.headline: Eagles win first Super Bowl
sport.summary: Philadelphia upsets New England in Minneapolis in February in a high-scoring thriller behind backup quarterback Nick Foles.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump impeached over Ukraine
geopolitical_news.summary: December impeachment on abuse-of-power charges for pressuring Kyiv; the Senate acquits him in 2020.

geopolitical_news.headline: Phase-one China trade deal
geopolitical_news.summary: December truce pauses tariff escalation after 18 months of tensions as both sides claim wins.

sport.headline: USWNT wins World Cup again
sport.summary: The Americans beat the Netherlands in Lyon in July to repeat as world champions before a global audience.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID-19 pandemic ravages the US
geopolitical_news.summary: Lockdowns spread in March; hundreds of thousands die as the economy craters, then partially recovers by fall.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biden defeats Trump
geopolitical_news.summary: November victory ends a bitter campaign as mail-in ballots tip key states; Trump refuses to concede defeat.

sport.headline: Sports shut down, then bubble up
sport.summary: Leagues halt in March; the NBA finishes its season in a Florida bubble, won by the Lakers.

geopolitical_news.headline: Capitol riot shocks the nation
geopolitical_news.summary: January 6 mob storms Congress in an unprecedented attack as lawmakers certify Biden's election victory.

geopolitical_news.headline: Chaotic withdrawal from Afghanistan
geopolitical_news.summary: August exit ends 20 years of war as evacuations turn desperate; the Taliban swiftly retakes Kabul.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biden's domestic agenda advances
geopolitical_news.summary: March stimulus and November infrastructure bill pass on party lines amid inflation worries.

sport.headline: US tops Tokyo's medal table
sport.summary: Americans win 113 medals at the delayed Games in August, edging China in golds.

geopolitical_news.headline: US rallies behind Ukraine
geopolitical_news.summary: February Russian invasion triggers massive American military aid and sanctions coordinated with European allies, worth tens of billions.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dobbs ends federal abortion rights
geopolitical_news.summary: June Supreme Court ruling in a 6-3 decision overturns Roe v. Wade, returning the issue to states.

sport.headline: USMNT returns to the World Cup
sport.summary: The Americans reach the round of 16 in Qatar in a young squad's debut before falling to the Netherlands.

geopolitical_news.headline: Debt-ceiling standoff resolved
geopolitical_news.summary: A June deal between Biden and McCarthy averts a first-ever US default after weeks of brinkmanship.

geopolitical_news.headline: US backs Israel after October 7
geopolitical_news.summary: Hamas attack triggers American military aid and a regional crisis as the Gaza war begins, drawing protests at home.

sport.headline: Messi mania hits American soccer
sport.summary: Lionel Messi joins Inter Miami in July, transforming MLS's profile overnight and selling out stadiums nationwide.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump wins comeback election
geopolitical_news.summary: November victory over Kamala Harris makes him the second president to win non-consecutive terms in a decisive return.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biden drops out, Harris steps in
geopolitical_news.summary: July withdrawal after a disastrous debate upends the Democratic ticket, making Harris the nominee with 100 days to go.

sport.headline: US shines at the Paris Olympics
sport.summary: Americans top the Paris medal table with 126 medals, most of any nation, led by Biles and Ledecky.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump's second term begins
geopolitical_news.summary: January inauguration launches mass deportations and a federal workforce overhaul with sweeping executive orders on day one.

geopolitical_news.headline: Liberation Day tariffs shock markets
geopolitical_news.summary: Sweeping April tariffs ignite a global trade war and market turmoil, with rates unseen in a century.

sport.headline: Eagles deny Chiefs' three-peat
sport.summary: Philadelphia routs Kansas City in New Orleans in February to win Super Bowl LIX, ending the dynasty bid.
